_readme: Single source of truth for FastAPI service routing on userver (Ubuntu/systemd). The env block is the ONLY place that controls LLM/OCR/ASR routing — change URLs here, then `sudo systemctl restart dreamcision-fastapi`. AI servers run as systemd units (vllm-*, whisper-*); no model paths belong here.

env._comment: DeepSeek 8004 (text) and Qwen-Vision 8001 (OCR/vision) are cross-wired as each other's fallback for TEXT-only features (P2-1): Qwen3.5-4B-Vision is a real multimodal LLM and can serve degraded text completions if DeepSeek is down, just with a much smaller 16K context vs DeepSeek's 196K -- very long charts may still fail over to the fallback. The reverse direction does NOT work: DeepSeek V4 Flash has no vision capability at all, so OCR/QA_VISION have no viable same-box fallback and are deliberately left unset rather than silently routing image requests to a model that can't read images. ASR moved to RTX 5090 (192.168.0.9), ports 8095-8096.
